title: Venezuelan Queso Frito
description: A crispy fried cheese snack from Venezuela, perfect for a quick snack or appetizer. This recipe is easy to make and requires minimal ingredients.
instructions: In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, garlic powder, and salt.
In a separate dish, beat the eggs.
Cut the Queso Fresco into 1-inch cubes.
Dip each cube of Queso Fresco into the flour mixture, coating evenly.
Then, dip the flour-coated Queso Fresco into the beaten eggs, making sure they are fully coated.
Roll the egg-coated Queso Fresco in the flour mixture again to coat evenly.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
When the oil is hot, add a few of the coated Queso Fresco cubes to the skillet.
Fry the Queso Fresco until golden brown and crispy, about 2-3 minutes on each side.
Remove the fried Queso Fresco from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Repeat the frying process with the remaining Queso Fresco cubes.
